_comment: BOBBLEDOWN - the round world. A walk-and-wonder world that breaks from the pixel art: everything was BREATHED, not built, by the Old Burbler asleep under the Fizzwell, so nothing has a corner. Eight regions ring the fizzing lagoon: Popping Green (where you arrive), the High Hush, Gumdrop Hills, the Puffwood, Jellybottom, Lollipop Grove, the Bubblefield and the Pillow Dunes. It RE-SKINS ITSELF through its 'art' block: a SOFT ground (pastel dapples, ribbon paths, fizzing ponds), smooth @2x growths/props/creatures (pokepals/tools/gen_bobbledown.py), drifting bubbles and a pastel actor_look. Native creatures (bobbling, puffkin, wobbler, rollypoll, bubblefin) are ambient pals with lore in data/pals.json. Its SECRET: ring all seven chime-bubbles in one visit and the Burbler's first breath rises. Generated by tools/gen_bobbledown_world.py - edit that and re-run, don't hand-tune positions.
intro: Everything here is round, and soft, and humming. You feel a little square. Touch things: they wobble back.

props.label: a round signboard
props.lore: WELCOME TO BOBBLEDOWN, says the sign, in very round letters. Underneath, smaller: "Everything here was breathed, not built. Mind the bubbles. They're somebody's."

props.label: a soft candy bench
props.lore: The bench gives a little when you lean on it, like a cushion, and then very slowly puffs itself back up.

props.label: a cloud cushion
props.lore: A scrap of cloud that's settled down for a rest. It's warm on top, like somebody was just sitting on it.

props.label: a bubble-lamp
props.lore: A lamp that's a bubble on a stick. The light inside it drifts about, as if it's looking for the way out and is in no hurry to find it.

props.label: a marshmallow stone
props.lore: The Fizzwell fizzes all the time, never stopping, never hurrying. Bobblings come here to listen. They say it sounds like snoring, if you listen long enough.

props.label: a bench facing the water
props.lore: From here you can watch the bubbles rise out of the Fizzwell and drift off over the world. Every one of them is going to be something, one day.

props.label: a fizzing spring
props.lore: A little spring, fizzing up from underneath. It tickles your fingers and smells faintly of lemons.

props.label: a fizzing spring
props.lore: The spring fizzes harder when you touch it, as if it's laughing.

props.label: an old round sign
props.lore: "Down at the bottom of the Fizzwell sleeps the Old Burbler, round as a moon and soft as a cloud. Every breath it takes in its sleep rises as a bubble, and every bubble that ever rose became something: a hill, a tree, a bobbling. That is why nothing here has a corner."

props.label: a listening stone
props.lore: Carved into the stone, very small: "They say the Burbler's first breath never popped. They say it's kept safe down there, waiting for someone to sing the Burbler its lullaby. Seven notes, kept in seven chime-bubbles, all over Bobbledown."

props.label: a bench on the hush
props.lore: It's very quiet up here. You can hear the Fizzwell below, and every so often a pop, very small and very far away.

props.label: a sugared stone
props.lore: The gumdrops grow a little every time it rains. It rains sugar here, about once a year, and everyone goes outside with their mouths open.

props.label: a bench in the Puffwood
props.lore: The puff-trees are softer than they look, and they look very soft. Some of the puffkins live inside them.

props.label: a stone by the pools
props.lore: The pools in Jellybottom are just a little thicker than water. Drop a pebble in and it sinks slowly, wobbling, and the wobblers all turn to watch.

props.label: a striped signpost
props.lore: LOLLIPOP GROVE, says the sign. Then: PLEASE DO NOT LICK THE TREES. Then, underneath in different handwriting: they don't mind really.

props.label: a bubble-watcher's stone
props.lore: The bubble-blooms here open into bubbles instead of petals. When one pops, another starts to grow in its place, slowly, like a held breath.

props.label: a sunken cloud cushion
props.lore: The dunes are made of something like marshmallow, sun-warm and soft. Walking on them leaves round footprints that puff back up behind you.

props.label: a chime-bubble
props.lore: A chime-bubble on its curly stand, a little note curled up inside it. It rings one round, warm note when you touch it.

_secret_comment: This world's one SECRET (docs/home-world-and-secrets-design.md, W-6). 'reveal' says how it becomes findable (see SecretDirector / Server.SecretReveal): touch_all -- ring every chime-bubble in 'props' in one visit; each one reads the next of 'lines', and the last raises the first breath at 'position'.

secret.lore: The Old Burbler's very first breath: a bubble that has never popped, not once, in all the ages since. It's warm, and it hums the lullaby very quietly to itself.

lines: The chime-bubble rings one round, warm note. Far below the Fizzwell, something very big turns over in its sleep.
A second note, a little higher, joins the first and hangs in the air. The bubbles in the Fizzwell rise a little faster.
Three notes now. Somewhere nearby, a bobbling starts humming along, not very well.
Four notes. It's starting to sound like a tune: a slow, rocking one, the kind you sing to someone asleep.
Five notes. The Fizzwell is fizzing hard now, as if something down there is listening.
Six. The lullaby is almost whole. Just one chime-bubble left, somewhere you haven't been yet.
reveal.again_line: It rings its note again, round and warm. You've already sung this part of the lullaby.
reveal.reveal_line: The seventh note rings, and the whole lullaby hangs over Bobbledown at once. Down in the Fizzwell the Old Burbler sighs in its sleep, and a single, very old bubble rises to the lagoon's south shore.

secret.found_line: The Burbler kept its first breath safe all this time. Now it's let you carry it home.

keepsake.label: the first breath, in a cup
keepsake.line: Your companion nudges the bubble with its nose. It wobbles, and doesn't pop. It never will.
